item.title: Trump Appoints ‘Alpha Male’ Influencer Who Posts About ‘Boobs’ and ‘Beautiful Curvy Women’ to Serve as Special Presidential Envoy
item.description: Nick Adams, the "Alpha Male" influencer known for posting about his passion for Hooters, boobs, and "curvy women," announced he had been appointed by Trump.

item.title: We’re at War With Iran and Nobody Can Trust What Trump Says
item.description: The U.S. is at war with Iran, and Trump is making unverifiable claims about it — forcing allies, adversaries, and the media to react before truth catches up.

item.title: ONE SHEET: CNN’s Looming Cuts, From Radio Caller to Federal Policy, and Trump’s Mueller Death Diss
item.description: In today's one sheet we note looming cuts at CNN, how a radio caller's suggestion led to federal policy and Trump's death diss of Robert Mueller.

item.title: ‘I’m Not Working for You Hacks!’ Kara Swisher Vows to Leave CNN If the Ellisons Buy It
item.description: CNN's Kara Swisher vowed to leave the network if Paramount Skydance successfully acquires its parent company, Warner Bros. Discovery.

item.title: Trump Cast Vote by Mail Before He Called It Cheating
item.description: Trump voted by mail in a recent special election on Tuesday — the day after he called for an end to the practice that he branded "mail-in cheating."

item.title: US Citizen Released by Taliban After More Than a Year in ‘Near-Solitary Confinement’
item.description: Dennis Coyle, the Colorado man who had been detained by the Taliban for more than a year, has been released and will return home.

item.title: Trump Tells Local Anchor He Was Pals With ‘Elvis Has Left the Building’ Hotel Manager
item.description: President Donald Trump told a local news anchor he was friends with the hotel manager whose venue popularized the iconic phrase "Elvis has left the building!"

item.title: ‘Clown’ PAC: Conservative Radio Star Nukes CPAC From Orbit Over Schlapp and Bannon
item.description: Conservative radio star Erick Erickson submitted that "the 'C' in CPAC is now best represented by the world 'clown'" on X Wednesday.

item.title: Dem Senator Rages at Trump Over ‘Freaking Stupid’ War: Latinos Believe Trump Is ‘Going to Sacrifice Our Kids’
item.description: Sen. Ruben Gallego accused Trump of having "no plan" on the Iran War and said he has been "so freaking stupid" in how he has conducted Operation Epic Fury.

item.title: House Democrat GOES OFF on Michigan Senate Candidate’s Rally With Hasan Piker
item.description: "We must call out hate & reject those who champion ideologies of exclusion and demonization,” wrote Schneider of Hasan Piker

item.title: ‘Why Is That Noble?’ Dennis Prager Rips Tucker Carlson for Saying ‘His Only Loyalty Is to the American People’
item.description: Conservative radio host and PragerU founder Dennis Prager criticized Tucker Carlson on Tuesday for saying "his only loyalty is to the American people."

item.title: Pro-Trump UFC Fighter Who Was Snubbed From White House Event Says He’s Done With Politics: ‘Loyalty Is Never Rewarded’
item.description: Pro-Trump UFC star Colby Covington on Tuesday claimed he'll no longer be involved in politics after he was excluded from the upcoming White House event.

item.title: Philly DA Threatens to Jail ICE Agents Working at Airport: ‘The President Cannot Pardon You!’
item.description: Philadelphia DA Larry Krasner threatened ICE agents working at the airport that he will throw them in jail if they make it look "anything like" Minneapolis

item.title: ONE SHEET: Hegseth’s End Run, the $580M Iran Bet, Bari Weiss’s Rough Quarter
item.description: In today's One Sheet, we track how Pete Hegseth is keeping his battle with the Pentagon press alive, millions made off an Iran bet, and Bari Weiss ratings woes.

item.title: ‘Do Your Homework!’ Democrat Rips Trump Official for Refusing to Say Whether Putin Is a ‘War Criminal’ in Fiery Hearing
item.description: Rep. Bill Keating (D-MA) grilled Under Secretary of State for Arms Control and International Security Thomas DiNanno during a tense Wednesday House hearing.
